about: Marketing and growth log for Pep Shop Texas. Claude adds what was done each week; the Thursday report (pst-weekly) reads entries dated within the week and the 'next' list.

entries.title: Gold Standard lab reports live on product pages
entries.detail: A 'Verified by Gold Standard' box with every test result, read live from the lab. Trust is the #1 reason buyers pick a peptide shop.

entries.title: Gold Standard lab connected in the owner app
entries.detail: Order tests from the app; certificates attach to the right product by item #.

entries.title: Vial picture options (Jimmie's report #15)
entries.detail: Clear 3/5/10ml or amber 10ml, powder or liquid, four fill colors.

entries.title: SEO audit of pepshoptexas.com
entries.detail: Found product pages Google couldn't index, no product data for search results, a stale sitemap and no content pages. Fixed the same night (see below).

entries.title: Growth plan and Thursday report set up
entries.detail: Benchmarked the big peptide shops (no paid ads), wrote the backlog, and scheduled this report every Thursday at 8 AM.

entries.title: Product pages Google can read (33) and 4 Central Texas pages
entries.detail: Each product has its own page with price, stock and lab info. New pages for Waco pickup, Temple/Killeen, Austin and Dallas–Fort Worth. Sitemap rebuilds nightly.

entries.title: Old product links now land on the new product pages
entries.detail: product.html links and the 29 picture-share links forward to each product's own page, so Google sees one address per product.

entries.title: Testing page: Gold Standard added, how to verify a COA
entries.detail: New Gold Standard card, 4 steps to check a certificate with the lab, and a title aimed at 'third party tested peptides' searches.

entries.title: Testing page no longer lists GLP-1 and Rx-type products
entries.detail: Per Mike: their lab reports stay on their own (hidden-from-Google) product pages, off the public testing page.

entries.title: Google Search Console verification file added
entries.detail: Mike started Search Console; the verification file is live so he can verify and submit the sitemap.
